justification: Standard: changes what /api/property returns when an outside source or the database fails (null plus a named not-checked list instead of a filled-in value), and adds one time limit for the whole lookup. Not Critical: no database writes, no schema change; every answered source gives the same reply as before (recorded-reply test).

pre_impl.existing_data: No database change. The lookup reads NSW Planning Portal, valuation, lot, TOD, hazard and road services, plus PostGIS spatial_overlays and nsw_cadastre_lots (read only).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: The code assumed an empty list or false from a failed call meant the lot had nothing. A failed, timed-out or 429 call tells us nothing, so those facts are now null and named in constraints.notChecked.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Extends the existing uncheckedHazards pattern (lib/hazard-unchecked.ts) with lib/lookup-not-checked.ts for non-hazard checks, and changes the existing lib/fetch-timeout.ts helper instead of adding a new one.

falsifiable_check.fails_when: Any single fix is undone: 28 mutations, each restoring one old fill-in (Class 5, 40%, R2 routing, heritage false, planning layers [], TOD dropped, roads [], 0,0 location, valuation read as not found, timer stopping at headers, no overall limit, and others).
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before the fix: 4 of 6 tests failed, including 23 filled-in values listed by the walker (heritage false, Class 5, 40%, SEPP routing, isStrata false). After the fix: 10 of 10 pass. Break-check script undid each of the 28 fixes in turn: all 28 turned the file red, then the file was restored.

functions.name: fetchWithTimeout
functions.input: url, init, per-call ms; reads the lookup time limit from AsyncLocalStorage
functions.output: Response whose body is already read, or a rejection on failure, per-call timeout or the lookup running out of time
functions.if_none: No lookup time limit running: only the per-call timer applies

functions.name: NSWPlanningPortalService.getPropertyComplianceData
functions.input: the street address the user typed, as one string
functions.output: property data with constraints.notChecked naming each check that did not answer; null only when the search found no such property
functions.if_none: Valuation failure or no location throws, so the route answers 503, never 404 not found

functions.name: uncheckedExclusions
functions.input: the pattern-book constraints built from the /api/property reply
functions.output: exclusions that cannot be tested (flood, bush fire, heritage, acid sulfate)
functions.if_none: No environmental object means flood and bush fire are listed as not checked

functions.name: scan
functions.input: the text of one source file, read line by line
functions.output: each line that turns an unknown heritage, strata, corner lot or acid sulfate answer into No, false or a pass
functions.if_none: An empty file gives no findings; a line marked unknown-ok with a reason is skipped

functions.name: heritageAnswer / acidSulfateAnswer / yesNo
functions.input: a heritage object or boolean, or the lookup constraints with notChecked
functions.output: true, false or null (not checked); yesNo prints Not checked for null
functions.if_none: undefined input reads as not checked, never as No
